strings.To use fn, set System Settings → Keyboar: fn’dan foydalanish uchun Tizim sozlamalari → Klaviatura → “🌐 tugmasi bosilganda” ni “Hech narsa qilmaslik” ga o‘rnating.
strings.Too long for one message (4,096 characte: Bitta xabar uchun juda uzun (ko‘pi bilan 4 096 belgi).
strings.Turn it on once with `hermes plugins ena: Uni bir marta `hermes plugins enable coucou` bilan yoqing, so‘ng yangi Hermes seansini boshlang.
strings.Turn off another pill to make room for W: WhatsApp’ga joy ochish uchun boshqa tugmachani o‘chiring (ko‘pi bilan {max} ta).
strings.Unofficial integration: it goes through: Norasmiy integratsiya: u shu kompyuterda siz ishga tushiradigan shlyuz orqali ishlaydi. Undan faqat o‘z hisobingizda foydalaning. WhatsApp suiiste’mol qiladigan hisoblarni cheklashi mumkin.
strings.Until Parakeet is downloaded, Coucou use: Parakeet yuklab olinmaguncha Coucou Mac’ingizning nutqni tanish tizimidan foydalanadi.
strings.Used by the chat. The list comes from yo: Chat foydalanadi. Ro‘yxat Anthropic hisobingizdan olinadi.
strings.Use only the address, like wss://relay.e: Faqat manzilning o‘zini yozing, masalan wss://relay.example.workers.dev
strings.The access key is 43 characters of lette: Kirish kaliti harflar, raqamlar, - va _ dan iborat 43 ta belgidan tashkil topgan
